text:
Jordan (eng-platform): Heads-up — SturgeonHealth's private rollout staging canary is failing the telemetry prober. Can someone own the network/egress side? :eyes:
Sasha (netops): On it. What exactly is failing? any logs or curl output?
Jordan (eng-platform): Prober POST to our telemetry endpoint returns 503 from their VPC. Short log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-15T12:03:14Z] prober.go: attempt 1 -> POST https://telemetry.redwood.example/api/v1/ingest => 503
curl output: "HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable"
```
Jordan (eng-platform): This was from their staging jumpbox. Looks like requests are being intercepted/blocked by their egress proxy or air-gap appliance.
Sasha (netops): Could be SNI rewrite / TLS interception. Can you run `curl -v https://telemetry.redwood.example:443` from that jumpbox and paste the output? Also, do you have the NAT/ALB IP ranges the customer expects to allow?
Leah (customer-ops): SturgeonHealth ops reported the smoke as "blocked by network" at 10:45. Their ops lead Mike says they won't open firewall rules until we coordinate a cert install.
Jordan (eng-platform): I ran curl earlier, pasted the raw output:
```
* Connected to telemetry.redwood.example (10.0.0.12) port 443 (#0)
* TLS handshake error: certificate verify failed
* Closing connection 0
```
Jordan (eng-platform): Looks like their proxy is doing TLS interception — cert mismatch on our side. triage-bot also fired an alert: https://redwood/inbox/alerts/ABC-123 :warning:
Sasha (netops): If the appliance is doing TLS interception they need to install the CA on the jumpbox or we can offer a short-lived mTLS option. What CN/SANs are on our cert currently?
Jordan (eng-platform): Cert CN=telemetry.redwood.example, SANs=[telemetry.redwood.example, telemetry.internal.redwood]. We can generate a staging cert with alternate SANs if needed. :thinking:
Leah (customer-ops): Customer target go-live is Fri 3/19. If netops can't get a workaround or cert installed by Thu EOD this will block go-live.
Sasha (netops): I'll own the runbook for this. Options: (1) get customer to install our CA on their appliance/jumpbox (fast), (2) provide a staging cert matching their interception CN (short term), or (3) stand up a customer-approved jumpbox proxy that routes allowed IPs. ETA: EOD Thu for CA install workaround, or Wed for jumpbox proxy. Assigning to myself. :thumbsup:
Jordan (eng-platform): Can you add the acceptance-test checklist item to the cutover board and tag me? I'll coordinate scheduling with their ops for the cert install Wednesday morning.
Sasha (netops): Will do. Also need confirmation of their egress IP ranges and whether the airgap appliance rewrites SNI. @Leah can you get those details from the customer?
Leah (customer-ops): Pinged Mike — he said he can share IP ranges by COB today. :white_check_mark:
triage-bot: Alert ABC-123 updated: owner=sasha (netops), status=investigating
Jordan (eng-platform): Added a blocking flag on the rollout card. If we get ranges + CA by COB we can rerun staging canary tomorrow night.
Leah (customer-ops): I'll update stakeholders once Mike confirms details.
Sasha (netops): Quick heads-up: if we go mTLS we need security sign-off. @Nora (security) can you be on standby for a review if the customer requests mTLS?
Nora (security): On standby. If they need mutual TLS we'll need their public key and to schedule a cert rotation window.
Jordan (eng-platform): Thanks all. I'll follow up with updated canary logs and the temporary runbook in the morning. :wave:
